tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

options.text: leaching of bauxite using concentrated NaOH solution gives sodium aluminate and sodium silicate

the blistered appearance of copper during the metallurgical process is due to the evolution of  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>
pig iron is obtained from cast iron
the Hall-Heroult process is used for the production of aluminium and iron

solution.text:
(1) During leaching when bauxite is treated with concentrated NaOH, then sodium aluminate and sodium silicate is formed in the soluble form, whereas Fe2O3 is precipitated.

(2) The blistered appearance of copper during the metallurgical process is due to the evoluation of SO2 .

Cu2S+2Cu2O→6Cu+SO2

(3) Cast iron is obtained from pig iron

Pig iron4% →blast of air cast iron3%

(4) Hall-Heroult process is used for production of only aluminium.
